title: OutlookMailboxReference
description: Mailbox context captured with a message reference. Local IDs are scoped to the originating Outlook installation; emailAddress identifies the mailbox owner, including a shared mailbox, not necessarily the signed-in user.

mailboxId.description: Local sidecar mailbox ID. Both the compact Outlook RPC spelling and the UUID spelling used by search are accepted. Not a Microsoft Graph mailbox ID or a portable device identity.

emailAddress.description: SMTP address of the mailbox owning the referenced item, when known.

profileName.description: Name of the originating Outlook profile, when available. A profile name alone does not identify a mailbox.
